day_shape: 84 items on October 7 third anniversary: IRGC adviser Nagdi claims Strait of Hormuz 'closed', Pezeshkian–Putin birthday call, London court hears Iranian spying case against Iran International, 11 Western Hemisphere states issue joint statement on Iranian 'terrorist actions', no UK Parliament or OFAC traffic.

threads.label: October 7 third anniversary commemorations
threads.summary: Israeli outlets and the IDF marked three years since the Hamas-led attack with memorial events, a Tel Aviv moment of silence for the 1,200 killed, and figures including 412 bereaved partners of fallen soldiers. Times of Israel tracked 262 pro-Palestinian events in 37 countries, Paris banned a planned Gaza protest, and the Israeli consulate invited NYC Mayor Mamdani to view invasion footage.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz closure claims
threads.summary: IRGC commander-in-chief adviser Nagdi told Iranian state media that the Strait of Hormuz is 'closed' under armed forces control and that 'illegal routes' used for oil smuggling will shortly be blocked. Fars News, IRIB and Defa Press carried the remarks, which also pledged to extend weapons range on the supreme leader's orders.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and US pressure track
threads.summary: VP JD Vance said Washington remains open to an Iran deal but demands concrete nuclear concessions, while Trump said nobody knows who runs Iran and Institute for Science satellite imagery showed activity at a suspected covert nuclear site. Iranian officials said oil exports have fallen to zero as the rial trades near record lows, with Iran International reporting diplomacy back to 'square one'.

threads.label: Iran extraterritorial operations in UK and West
threads.summary: London prosecutors told court three Iranian men spied on Iran International journalists to aid Iranian intelligence and prepare serious violence, while a suspected Iranian drone plot reportedly prompted the US to remove B-1 bombers from a British airbase. Eleven Western Hemisphere nations issued a joint statement condemning Iranian 'terrorist actions', and Namibia arrested two Iranian women impersonating Israelis.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iran has executed nearly two people a week in political and security cases since January, including Alireza Raisi whose burial site was concealed from his family, with 194 more facing death sentences. Amnesty detailed top-down coordination of the 2022 Woman Life Freedom crackdown, and internal surveys showed single-digit trust in officials and overwhelming demand for change.

threads.label: Tehran leadership messaging cycle
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried Pezeshkian telling cabinet Iran would 'resist and disappoint the enemy' and a Pezeshkian–Putin call marking Putin's birthday with pledges of continued strategic cooperation. Qalibaf told police commanders the enemy seeks internal insecurity, Foreign Minister Muttaki displayed effects of 'American terrorist attacks' at an IPU meeting, and IRGC's Abdollahi hailed the Al-Aqsa Storm anniversary.

threads.label: Yemen Houthi strikes and ground fighting
threads.summary: Houthis launched missiles at Yemen's Aden airport and the Saudi cities of Riyadh and Khamis Mushait, with Saudi-led coalition media reporting an interception. Jerusalem Post reported Yemeni government forces drove armoured vehicles over Houthi fighters while recapturing areas around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
